name: Heber C. Kimball
role: Member of the first Quorum of the Twelve
dateNote: He was ordained an apostle on 14 February 1835 and led the first mission to Britain in 1837.
importance: Heber C. Kimball was a potter from Mendon, New York, baptized in April 1832. He became one of the first Twelve Apostles in 1835. In June 1837 he left Kirtland to open the mission in England, the background to section 112. Section 124 lists him among the Twelve at Nauvoo, and he later served as first counselor to Brigham Young.
connections: He married Vilate Murray in 1822. He served beside Brigham Young, Orson Hyde, and the other apostles named in section 124.

sources.title: Heber Chase Kimball, Joseph Smith Papers biography
